ticket_shown_to_model.title: Report Builder audit log gaps detected
ticket_shown_to_model.description: I'm seeing gaps in our audit logs when using the Report Builder tool in our US-West production environment. We have noticed that certain actions do not appear to be recorded. This is affecting a small group of about 17 users who are trying to track changes for internal review. I believe the Report Builder itself is failing to log these events correctly. Can you look into why the audit trail is incomplete?

parsed.summary: The Report Builder tool is suspected to be failing to log certain events correctly, resulting in gaps in the audit logs, affecting a small group of 17 users.
